description: Sets the message banned users see (above a form to write to you) and the one terminated users see (no form). Pass at least one; applies at once. Neblla's default shows in the user's language, yours as written. Does not ban: neblla_set_ban_status.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

bannedMessage.description: New text; "" restores the default; omitted, unchanged.

terminatedMessage.description: New text; "" restores the default; omitted, unchanged.

name: neblla_ban_settings
title: Set the ban messages
